falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current HOLD verdict assumes we are in a distribution/consolidation phase similar to August 2024. A decisive breakout above the prior cycle high would invalidate the 'top forming' thesis and signal continuation, not exhaustion.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total altcoin market cap (excluding BTC and ETH) gains more than 25% in 7 days while BTC dominance drops below 52%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to August 2024 bottom implies capital rotating INTO BTC for safety. A violent altcoin rally with BTC dominance collapsing would mean risk appetite is expanding aggressively, contradicting the cautious HOLD stance and suggesting a broad risk-on regime instead of a local top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rates on BTC perpetual swaps stay above 0.05% for 10 consecutive days without any significant price correction (less than 5% drawdown from peak)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 41 suggests moderate overheating but not terminal euphoria. Sustained positive funding with no flush would mean leveraged longs are being rewarded, not punished — invalidating the 'blowoff top' risk component and indicating the market can absorb leverage without a reset.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
